absenceCheck.method: planStagedDirectory-equivalent id via computeHobbyIqCardId + insert-set-key.cjs planFile/finalIdFor from backend/dist, point-read card_catalog (pk=/cardId + None-partition shape) read-only, plus sibling-rung-twin query (same sport+year+cardNumber, cross-setKey, checklist-authority + namesAgree filter) for every absent row's cardNumber.
absenceCheck.pattern: The 329 sibling-twin rows are EXACTLY the full 47-card x 7-rung Series Two roster (47*7=329) -- Series Two 1990 Topps Baseball Relics (90R2-) already exists in full, at checklist authority, under setKey=topps-series-2 (source=beckett-scraped-2026-08-26), same cardNumber/rung/player. The 98 present-checklist rows are exactly the 98 Series One (T90R-) blank-parallel base rows (source=beckett-s3-2026-09-20). The 528 staged rows are the remaining Series One (T90R-) parallel rungs (Blue/Gold/Orange/Black/Red/Platinum) that have neither a checklist-grade present row nor a sibling-key twin -- ALL staged rows carry the T90R- prefix; zero 90R2- rows are staged.

ownerRuling: T90R- (Series One only) lives under `topps`. 90R2- (Series Two) is excluded in full: it is already fully addressable under `topps-series-2` and restaging it under `topps` would split one card's pool across two setKeys (one card, one row, one pool).
